name: Prospective Cows2021 date-grouped roles v1
scope: Metadata-only candidate roles after complete10402XML recovery; eligibility for final independent evaluation remains pending image/source duplication audit.
selection_basis: Chronological dates, public split-boundary provenance and previously observed raw-video dates; no new model prediction or metric used.
prior_access_rule: Existing Cows2021 March8/9 raw clips were used for development; neither date is a new final date holdout.
group_unit: Complete source date across published Train/validation/Test roles. XML block and timestamp do not independently prove a video session ID.
same_original_filename: Report duplicate source names; same source date must always get same candidate role. Do not infer byte identity from source name alone.
missing_or_bad_fields: Preserve all10402metadata rows, flag/quarantine missing or invalid capture dates rather than silently dropping records.
further_eligibility_gates: All metadata rows and source XML hashes independently verified
Actual image bytes and complete decode checked for selected development data
Exact/pixel/near-source overlap against prior OpenCows and prior used footage reviewed
Candidate final dates retained without score-based selection
Passage evaluation uses independent events and a consistent body-reference definition
